misconceptions.description: Assuming a citation means the claim is backed up.
misconceptions.trigger: learner keeps a claim because it has a reference
misconceptions.feedback: Check that the source exists and actually says the claim. Citations can be invented.

misconceptions.description: Trusting a whole answer because parts were right.
misconceptions.trigger: learner stops checking after two correct claims
misconceptions.feedback: Check claim by claim. One correct claim does not vouch for the next.
